title: SafeAtlas-VL: Beyond Binary Multimodal Safety with Large-Scale Data and Guard Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.29098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal safety moderation requires distinguishing risks arising from visual content, user intent, and assistant behavior. Existing safeguards, however, are typically trained for a single judgment target and reduce safety assessment to a binary decision. Consequently, risk becomes difficult to compare across a multimodal interaction, and ambiguous cases are obscured. We introduce SafeAtlas-VL, a dataset of 1.5M training instances that places image-, request-, and response-level judgments on a five-level ordered scale. We curate a broad collection of safety-relevant data from both real-world and synthetic sources and apply a disagreement-aware annotation procedure. The resulting dataset spans 15 harm categories and 55 fine-grained subcategories, covering a broad range of multimodal safety scenarios. We also construct SafeAtlas-Bench, a held-out set of 5,000 instances for evaluating five-level predictions and continuous risk scores. Upon

translated_title: SafeAtlas-VL：超越二元多模态安全——基于大规模数据与守护模型
translated_abstract: 多模态安全审核需要区分来自视觉内容、用户意图和助手行为的风险。然而，现有的安全防护措施通常仅针对单一判断目标进行训练，并将安全评估简化为二元决策。因此，风险难以在多模态交互中进行比较，模糊的案例也被掩盖。我们提出了SafeAtlas-VL，一个包含150万个训练实例的数据集，将图像级、请求级和响应级判断置于五级有序量表上。我们从真实世界和合成来源中筛选了广泛的安全相关数据，并应用了分歧感知的标注流程。所得数据集涵盖15个伤害类别和55个细粒度子类别，覆盖广泛的多模态安全场景。我们还构建了SafeAtlas-Bench，一个包含5000个实例的保留评测集，用于评估五级预测和连续风险分数。
tldr: 该论文提出了SafeAtlas-VL——一个包含150万实例的多模态安全数据集，将图像、请求和响应三个层面的安全判断从二元决策扩展为五级有序量表，并配套构建了SafeAtlas-Bench评测基准，覆盖15个伤害类别和55个细粒度子类别。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SafeAtlas-VL, a 1.5M-instance multimodal safety dataset that extends safety judgments from binary decisions to five-level ordered scales across image, request, and response levels, together with the SafeAtlas-Bench benchmark covering 15 harm categories and 55 fine-grained subcategories.
